title: Nuclear Tests Left a Timestamp in Your Body

voice.engine: kokoro-82m (onnx) — SCRATCH timing reference only, never published

lexicon.timestamp: T AY M S T AE M P

scenes.name: Hook: a timestamp in your body
The tests double the carbon in the air
1963: the ban, and the slow fade
Every new cell locks in the year
Stockholm: a clock for your cells
Revelation: the core of your eye lens

lines.text: Nuclear bomb tests left a timestamp in your body.
lines.delivery: Quiet and close, like a secret. Lean on 'timestamp', then put a little weight on 'your body'.

lines.text: In the fifties and sixties, they nearly doubled the radioactive carbon in the air.
lines.delivery: Documentary, steady. Let 'nearly doubled' sound genuinely surprising.

lines.text: In {1963|nineteen sixty-three}, most were banned, and it began to fade, year by year.
lines.delivery: Slower on 'year... by... year'. That rhythm is the whole trick of the story.

lines.text: Plants breathed it in. Animals ate the plants. So did you.
lines.delivery: Three steps, each a touch lower. A small smile on 'So did you.'

lines.text: Every new cell you make locks that year's level into its DNA.
lines.delivery: Clear and confident: this is the key idea. 'D-N-A' spelled out, unhurried.

lines.text: So scientists in Stockholm turned it into a clock for your cells.
lines.delivery: A turn: wonder. Land 'a clock for your cells' warmly.

lines.text: Your fat cells? About ten percent replaced every year.
lines.delivery: Light, almost playful. The question mark is a real question.

lines.text: Your heart? Barely one percent a year.
lines.delivery: Softer and slower: this one is a little moving.

lines.text: The neurons in your cortex? As old as you are.
lines.delivery: Matter-of-fact, then let 'as old as you are' sit for a beat.

lines.text: And the center of your eye lens...
lines.delivery: Lower, building. Suspend the pitch: the sentence continues.

lines.text: was made before you were born.
lines.delivery: The revelation. Slow, clean, almost a whisper on 'before you were born'.

lines.text: You're reading this through it, right now.
lines.delivery: Personal, intimate. Let the viewer feel it. Pause properly afterwards.

lines.text: And we can measure all of it because...
lines.delivery: Pick the energy back up, then hang on 'because...': the video loops straight into 'Nuclear bomb tests left a timestamp in your body.'
